slides.title: What Happened Tuesday, Nov 17
slides.body: Nvidia reported fiscal third-quarter revenue up 103% from a year earlier. Data center revenue was $107.6B, up 110%. Shares rose nearly 4% after hours.

slides.title: Nvidia Revenue
slides.subtitle: US dollars, billions
slides.body: Forecast is the LSEG consensus. Q4 outlook is Nvidia's own guidance, plus or minus 3%.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Chip stocks sold off before the report. On Nov 17 the Dow fell 848 points, the S&P 500 fell 1.0% and the Nasdaq fell 0.7%. The 10-year yield was near 5.1%.
